title: Mrs Zhou's Red Pen

pre.en: What is Mrs Zhou learning now?

intro: 一篇人物小传：小陈中学时最怕、也最敬重的英语老师周老师。读的时候留意过去完成进行时 had been doing：站在过去某个时间点（2008 年、全校朗读那天、去年春天）往回看，说某件事「到那时已经持续做了多久」，常和 for + 一段时间连用。

sentences.en: By the time Chen joined Mrs Zhou's English class in 2008, she'd been teaching at Number Two Middle School for twenty-two years.
sentences.zh: 2008 年小陈进周老师英语班的时候，她已经在二中教了二十二年书。

sentences.en: For most of those years, she'd been giving a dictation at twenty to eight every morning.
sentences.zh: 这些年里的大部分时间，她每天早上七点四十都要听写，雷打不动。

sentences.en: And her red pen was even more famous than she was.
sentences.zh: 她那支红笔，比她本人还出名。

sentences.en: Mrs Zhou was strict with everyone, even the physics teacher's son.
sentences.zh: 周老师对谁都严，连物理老师的儿子也不例外。

sentences.en: If you spoke Chinese in her lessons, she told you off.
sentences.zh: 谁在她课上说中文，她就训谁。

sentences.en: And she never went easy on anyone who forgot their homework.
sentences.zh: 忘带作业的人，她也从不手下留情。

sentences.en: "In this room, you think in English," she said every September.
sentences.zh: 「在这间教室里，你们要用英语思考，」每年九月她都这么说。

sentences.en: The school was on a budget, so she wrote her own listening tests from scratch.
sentences.zh: 学校经费紧张，她就自己从头编听力题。

sentences.en: Every night the marking piled up.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上，要批的作业都堆成山。

sentences.en: She carried it home in a brown bag that had gone out of fashion years before.
sentences.zh: 她就装进一个早就过时的棕色包里带回家。

sentences.en: She had a great sense of humour, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实她很有幽默感。

sentences.en: But her jokes were in English, so nobody laughed until a week later.
sentences.zh: 可她的笑话都是用英语讲的，所以大家总要过一个星期才听懂笑出来。

sentences.en: Chen was scared of her for most of his first year at secondary school.
sentences.zh: 上中学第一年，小陈大半时间都很怕她。

sentences.en: He'd been hiding at the back for months when she chose him to read a story aloud in front of the whole school.
sentences.zh: 他在最后一排躲了好几个月，结果她偏偏挑中他，让他在全校面前朗读一篇故事。

sentences.en: For two weeks he'd been practising in the bike shed at lunchtime, while his friends killed time playing cards.
sentences.zh: 那两个星期，他每天中午都躲在车棚里练，朋友们就在一旁打牌打发时间。

sentences.en: On the day, his hands were shaking, and she whispered, "Read at your own pace. Nobody's going anywhere."
sentences.zh: 到了那天，他的手一直在抖，她小声跟他说：「按你自己的节奏读，没人会走的。」

sentences.en: Unfortunately, she'd left the microphone on, so eight hundred students heard that too.
sentences.zh: 可惜她忘了关话筒，这句话八百个学生也全听见了。

sentences.en: From then on, Chen stopped hiding from her and started looking up to her.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，小陈不再躲着她，而是打心底里敬重她。

sentences.en: Last spring Chen found her on WeChat.
sentences.zh: 去年春天，小陈在微信上找到了她。

sentences.en: She was sixty-three, and she'd been learning Python for half a year.
sentences.zh: 那年她六十三岁，已经学了半年 Python。

sentences.en: She sent him a screenshot of her first program, full of red error messages.
sentences.zh: 她发给他一张截图，是她写的第一个程序，满屏都是红色的报错。

sentences.en: "Your turn to mark my homework," she wrote.
sentences.zh: 「这回轮到你给我批作业了，」她写道。

cards.note: give a dictation 是老师「报听写」；动词 dictate（口述、让人记下）。
to make someone follow rules and behave well, and not allow them to break the rules
cards.tip: 对人用 with，对某件事用 about：strict about homework。strict 本身是形容词，前面要有 be。
cards.example: My dad was very strict with us about bedtime.

cards.note: to speak angrily to someone because they have done something wrong
cards.tip: 为什么挨训用 for + doing；「挨训」常说 get told off：I got told off by my mum.
cards.example: The manager told me off for being late again.

cards.note: to treat someone more gently than usual and not criticise them too much
cards.tip: 常用在祈使句里替别人求情：Go easy on her。go easy on sth 还可以是「少吃点、少用点」：go easy on the salt。
cards.example: Go easy on him — it's only his second week.

cards.note: having only a limited amount of money to spend
cards.tip: 常说 on a tight budget（预算很紧）；budget 也能当动词：budget for sth（为……做预算）。
cards.example: We're travelling on a budget, so we're staying in hostels.

cards.note: from the very beginning, without using anything that already exists
英式说法，不可数；动词 mark 是「批改、打分」，美式多说 grade。
to become a large amount, often because you have not dealt with it
to stop being popular or fashionable
cards.tip: 反义是 come into fashion；也可以说 be out of fashion（已经过时了，说状态）。
cards.example: Long scarves went out of fashion and then came back again.

cards.note: to be able to see what is funny and to make people laugh
cards.tip: 英式拼写 humour，美式 humor；可以加形容词：a great / dry sense of humour。
cards.example: You need a good sense of humour if you work with teenagers.

cards.note: to be afraid of someone or something
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 doing：be scared of flying；突然被吓一跳是 get scared。
cards.example: My daughter is scared of dogs, even small ones.

cards.note: read aloud 是「念出声」，和 loudly（音量大）不完全一样。
bike shed 车棚；花园里放工具的小屋叫 garden shed。
to do something unimportant while you are waiting or have nothing to do
也能当名词：in a whisper（小声地）。
at the speed that is right for you, not the speed of other people
to not switch off a light or machine
cards.tip: sth 放在 leave 和 on 中间；反过来「一直关着」是 leave sth off。
cards.example: Did you leave the oven on again?

cards.note: to admire and respect someone, often someone older or more experienced
cards.tip: 反义是 look down on（瞧不起）；说的是长期的态度，不说 I'm looking up to her。
cards.example: I've always looked up to my older sister.
